cases.query: 如何描述曲线在某一点变化得有多快？
cases.document: 导数描述函数在指定位置的瞬时变化率，其几何意义是曲线在该点处切线的斜率。

cases.query: Why does this algorithm halve the remaining possibilities after every step?
cases.document: Binary search repeatedly compares against the middle element of a sorted array and discards the half that cannot contain the target.

cases.query: 两个矩阵可以相乘需要满足什么条件？
cases.document: 若 A 的维度是 m×n，B 的维度是 n×p，则乘积 AB 的维度是 m×p；左矩阵列数必须等于右矩阵行数。

cases.query: How do we adjust parameters so the objective becomes smaller?
cases.document: 梯度下降沿损失函数的负梯度方向更新参数，使目标函数逐步减小。

cases.query: Why does a model score well on training data but poorly on unseen data?
cases.document: Overfitting means learning training-specific patterns that do not generalize.

cases.query: 怎样知道工具调用真的把内容写进数据库了？
cases.document: 写入调用超时不能直接视为失败；应查询实际记录或调用幂等状态接口，核实已发生的写入效果后再决定是否重试。

cases.query: Why does binary search require sorted input?
cases.document: Binary search functions are sometimes written in Python.

cases.query: 用户在什么情况下能够删除银行卡并取消自动扣费？
cases.document: 用户可以在设置中调整头像显示大小和更换主题颜色。
